evidence_gaps: Missing runtime forensics to validate execution infrastructure reliability vs strategy logic failures.

Lack of EVM gas consumption bounds on complex routing paths.

proposals.downside_risk: Prolonged SHADOW testing consumes compute resources without generating live profit.

evidence.detail: Strategy hypothesis requires executable spread to remain positive after known fees, slippage, price impact, and latency reserve.

proposals.expected_effect: Gather out-of-sample data on routing failure rates and net execution outcomes against realistic gas/priority fees.
proposals.rationale: Without fresh runtime evidence distinguishing market losses from execution failures, we cannot verify if latency reserves and slippage estimations accurately reflect real network conditions on EVM and Solana.
proposals.shadow_test: Simulate trades on cross-venue spread > 0.5% keeping track of simulated transaction inclusion costs. Stop if simulated execution failure rate > 15%.

rejected_ideas.reason: Forbidden by lack of fresh runtime forensics. We cannot distinguish execution/infrastructure failures from strategy losses without recent runtime logs.

summary: Completed architecture-only strategy review. Runtime forensics are unavailable. Current strategy architectures in strategy_lab.py (e.g., Cross Venue Net Arbitrage, Liquidity Confirmed Momentum) are logically sound but must remain in SHADOW.
